summary.text: Campus life at NIT Trichy revolves around a large residential campus where nearly all students live in hostels. Student activity is organised under the Dean (Students' Welfare) into technical, cultural and social clubs, each with a faculty advisor, and the calendar is anchored by three student-run flagship events: Pragyan (techno-managerial fest, started 2005), Festember (cultural fest, started 1975, held in September) and NITTFEST, the inter-departmental cultural competition. Every department also runs its own two-day technical symposium, and the year in sports closes with Sportsfete. Facilities include a sports centre, a 400 m outdoor stadium and a 25 m pool.
